verdict.rationale: YPOG has a documented practice page titled "IP/IT/Data Protection", which shows a named data-protection practice. However, the only quoted content covers advising on IP assets and data-driven transactions, not privacy compliance counseling itself. missing for 10: explicit GDPR/CCPA/DPDP or local-law compliance advisory services, descriptions of privacy or cyber counseling scope (DPIAs, breach response, DPO support), named privacy practitioners, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice

citations.quote: transactions and joint ventures that are driven by content, technology and data
